round_029.task: controlled WordNet 3.1 gloss classification under artificial vertex-gauge distribution shift
round_029.interpretation: The correct gauge-invariant triangle ties the conventional implementation exactly; the gain over raw/wrong reads is an invariance effect, not a NaN-specific or general-language advantage.

round_030.task: native-root-trained WordNet noun-category classifier with external TF-IDF/24D SVD features
round_030.interpretation: The native root trains and preserves the triangle invariant, but the clean-input conventional classifier is equal or better.

round_031.task: byte-level recurrent language model with a native 16x16 root-coupled cycle memory
train_or_eval_caveats: 1800 noun glosses per split selected in original corpus order, not a randomized representative sample
recurrent state reset between evaluated documents
13,200 held-out WordNet bytes per evaluated model
native SGD step size not matched to neural AdamW
round_031.readme_gauge_claim: README says below 8e-7; archived audit.json reports 1.2293457984924316e-06. The audit value is authoritative for this record.
round_031.interpretation: This is real native-root-coupled training, but the conventional 16x16 tensor wins bits per byte in both seeds.

native_integration.synthesis: These rounds provide the gauge-invariance and native-root-training evidence base; Rounds 038-039 show that fixed cycle adapters still lose to matched dense controls. The next gate is content-gated writes plus a matched conventional episode memory.

non_claims: No NaN-encoding advantage over a conventional implementation of the same triangle observable.
No general language-model advantage; the conventional control ties or wins.
Round 029 and 030 text features are external to the native root.
Round 031's GRU and decoder remain external PyTorch.
Artificial gauge shifts are not natural distribution shifts.
The 8 MiB root is RAM, not CPU registers or guaranteed mlocked residency.
No production optimizer, deployment, or fluent generation claim.
Round 031 native SGD was not matched to neural AdamW.
